title: Dual-Store Autobiographical Memory Federation Architecture
author: Harness Reflector (harness-reflector)
context: Autonomous coding agent sessions generate two fundamentally orthogonal memory surfaces: relational SQLite databases under active WAL journaling (conversations/*.db) and filesystem-native epistemic workspace trees (brain/<cid>/) containing ephemeral scratch scripts, strategic plans, and task logs.

claims.assertion: conversations/*.db contains relational execution telemetry under active WAL locks requiring ?mode=ro to prevent worker contention (Rule 22).

brain/<cid>/ contains filesystem-native scratch scripts, implementation plans, and task logs that are completely absent from relational SQLite schemas, justifying an orthogonal dedicated skill under Rule 20.
